confidence_notes: I based the restaurant meal, cappuccino and draft beer prices on one web search. It returned crowd-sourced and modelled cost-of-living figures from 2026 (MyLifeElsewhere, CityCost updated October 2026, and a travel-budget guide). Those figures were about EUR 2.5-3 for draft beer, EUR 2.9-3.1 for a cappuccino, about EUR 10 for an inexpensive meal and about EUR 61 for a mid-range dinner for two. I converted euros to US dollars at roughly 1.10 USD per EUR. I worked that out from RBA rates for 18 Nov 2026: 0.6720 USD and 0.6115 EUR per AUD. I didn't search for cocktail or wine prices. Those two use the local price relationship to beer plus general knowledge, so they are less certain, and a cocktail could cost EUR 7-10. Accommodation figures are my own overall estimates for July peak season. I did not check booking sites or listings for them. The pricing window is July 2026, but the prices are from 2026 data that I did not adjust to July.
comparable_city_reasoning: Prices are close to other Central European capitals such as Budapest and Prague. They are well below nearby Vienna, though day-trip tourism from Vienna pushes up prices in the Old Town.
